statement.text:
b) What is the minimal possible rate of growth of the function π(n) = max |g|
                                                                                 δ(g)⩽n
for the class of groups indicated in part “a” of this problem (see Archive)? It is known
(R. I. Grigorchuk, Math. USSR–Izv., 25 (1985), 259–300) that there exist p-groups
with π(n) ⩽ nλ for some λ > 0. At the same time, it follows from a result of
E. I. Zel’manov that π(n) is not bounded if G is infinite.              R. I. Grigorchuk
